source_manifest.source_policy: Exact complete upstream files, including license and notice; no gate deletion or parameter changes.

records.name: qec_sm_n5

records.front_metric_scope: Ready-CX count in the recorded ASAP instruction fronts; not the maximum over all delayed schedules. Incomparable CX pairs separately capture other legal choices.
physical_rejection_reasons: Current homogeneous-basis CNOT profile does not preserve these original operations: barrier, if_else, x
records.semantics_policy: All original operations and classical dependencies retained; custom definitions expanded without deleting gates. No CNOT-only projection is called a full benchmark.
